To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
sustainable procurement is not implemented in Pakistan due to lack of awareness, lack of sustainability education, lack of government policies, and lack of stakeholders' pressure.

the implementation of sustainable public procurement is hindered by the lack of government support, the lack of knowledge and skills among employees, and the lack of a culture of sustainability within the organization.

external factors namely government legislation, stakeholder pressure and internal factors such as lack of awareness, lack of resources and lack of commitment are the key barriers that resist the implementation of sustainability procurement in Pakistan.

the barriers of sustainable procurement in the public sector and how they can be overcome.
the implementation of sustainable development through sustainable public procurement in the public sector of Pakistan.
the barriers that resist the implementation of Sustainable Procurement in the Public Sector of Pakistan.

sustainable procurement is a complex process and it requires a lot of effort to be implemented.
sustainable procurement is a key element for the sustainable development.

, the government should take the initiative to introduce sustainable procurement policies in Pakistan and also the stakeholders should put pressure on the government to make sustainable procurement a mandatory part of public procurement.
